IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: unusual p99 tail latency in inference-api (streaming path). Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/generate. p99 ~ 3.2s (baseline 0.7s), p95 ~ 1.1s. Errors: increased streaming stalls and 504s to some customers. Auto-escalating to #incidents. Link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/4467008123
Morgan (oncall): ack — I'm on it. Paging DB and control-plane. Starting blast radius check for EU and US regions. :mag:
Alex Chen: seeing a tight correlation with control-plane heartbeat errors to configstore: `heartbeat_write_timeout` spikes and a bunch of feature-flag sync writes pile up. DB pool metrics: `active_connections` hitting 95% and `wait_ms` spiking to 1200ms.
Samir K: grabbing recent logs from inference-gateway and controlplane-proxy. quick grep shows a burst of config writes at 18:32:02 across 3 hosts.
Alex Chen: paste of a short log tail:
```
controlplane-proxy[host-12] 2026-03-15T18:32:02.413Z WARN feature-sync write timeout=1200ms key=ff-service-weights
controlplane-proxy[host-12] 2026-03-15T18:32:02.416Z ERROR heartbeat failed: context deadline exceeded
inference-gateway[gw-3] 2026-03-15T18:32:02.521Z ERROR stream stalled id=abc123 token_wait=800ms
```
Riley Patel: are we seeing any recent deploys to controlplane or the FF service? I don't see a Canary in last 30m.
DB-Eng-Bot: alert -> db-pool-pressure: host=db-prod-2 connections=198/200 wait_avg=850ms qlen=42
Samir K: looks like a feedback loop: controlplane retries on heartbeat timeouts -> extra writes to configstore -> db contention -> auth lookups slow -> inference requests stall. KV cache miss rate for prefix cache jumped from 8% -> 62% at spike time.
Morgan (oncall): mitigation plan (short): 1) flip `ff-service-weights` sync to async/fail-open (reduce write pressure) 2) enable config cache fallback on inference-gateway 3) increase DB connection pool on proxies (temporary) 4) route high-latency customers to dedicated capacity variant. I'll run 1 and 2 now.
Alex Chen: commands to run: `kubectl exec -n controlplane cpctl -- set-env FF_SYNC_MODE=async && kubectl rollout restart deploy/controlplane-proxy` (doing now). Also toggling inference-gateway to use cached configs: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/feature/flip?gate=cache_fallback&on=true`
Product Support: flagged two paying customers (AcmePay, NovaML) reporting degraded streaming; ticket numbers 9982, 9983. Please include customer impact in postmortem.
Morgan (oncall): executed the env flip, restarting controlplane-proxy pods. Watching logs. Already seeing fewer write spikes in the last 20s.
Alex Chen: DB pool pressure decreasing on db-prod-2: active_connections 160 -> 88, wait_avg -> 120ms. p99 inference latency trending down to 0.95s.
Samir K: rolling back a retry policy in controlplane client to reduce write amplification (patched in place).
Riley Patel: I'll take the handoff in 15m. Morgan, if you still see elevated p99s at handoff time, escalate to oncall infra with prefix 'db-backpressure'.
Morgan (oncall): noted. Current status: partial mitigation applied, customer impact reduced but some streaming stalls persist for a minority of requests (p99 ~1.4s). Handoff to Riley at 19:05 UTC.
Riley Patel: taking over at 19:05 UTC. Next actions: queue a controlled canary for FF sync disable across EU, confirm no regressions, and prepare rollback plan. Also schedule postmortem draft with timelines and mitigations.
IncidentBot: incident state changed -> Mitigated (partial). Added tags: controlplane, db, heartbeat, streaming, p99.
Morgan (oncall): notes for postmortem: root cause hypothesis = feature-flag sync operation created a burst of writes that caused DB pool exhaustion and a feedback retry loop in control-plane clients. Immediate fixes: flip sync to async, enable cache fallback, reduce retry amplification. Follow-ups: hard limits on FF write rate, circuit-breaker when DB wait > 500ms, increase observability on KV cache miss rates.
Samir K: leaving final logs & traces in the incident doc. Will attach heap/metrics snapshots. :white_check_mark:
Product Support: adding customer impact summary and affected request IDs to ticket queue. Will request credits for impacted customers as needed.
Riley Patel: leaving TODOs for post-handoff: (1) confirm canary in eu-west stable after 30m (2) add automated rollback to prior FF sync config if DB waits > 400ms (3) run a load test to validate new rate-limits.
Morgan (oncall): handing off. good job team. Closing live triage, continue async in #incidents and oncall runbook update. :thumbsup:
